description: Armored bulwark - soaks damage behind a hardened exoskeleton. Bear-equivalent spec; Beetle Form is this spec's shapeshift, trading Mana for Rage.
_source_note: Rebuilt from CoA Build Hub screenshots (Sept 2026): 25 confirmed Fortitude nodes trimmed HARD to a lean 12-node tree per Kyle's bloat direction - this was the single biggest source list of any Venomancer spec, heavy on near-duplicate exoskeleton passives (Empowered/Regrow/Reinforced Exoskeleton, Reconstructive Carapace all did similar armor-stacking things) which were consolidated into fewer, stronger nodes. Exposed Flesh confirmed via tooltip as the Rage-generation mechanic: 'Hostile attacks against you now have a 50% chance to grant a stack of Exposed Flesh. Exposed Flesh generates 10 Rage and increases your Physical Damage taken 3% for 20 seconds, stacking 10 times.'

nodes.name: Exposed Flesh
nodes.description: Hostile attacks against you have a 50% chance to grant a stack of Exposed Flesh, generating 10 Rage.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Hostile attacks against you now have a 50% chance to grant a stack of Exposed Flesh. Exposed Flesh Generates 10 Rage and increases your Physical Damage taken 3% for 20 seconds, stacking 10 times.' This spec's core Rage-generation mechanic - the damage-taken-increase risk/reward clause is kept since it matches real WoW tank Rage generation (taking hits fuels your kit).

nodes.name: Hivebreak

nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 10, 'Pierce an enemy with your front leg, dealing 33 Nature damage.' Replaces an earlier unconfirmed guess ('Barbed Stinger').

nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 34, 'Spray poison on an enemy and all enemies near them, dealing 38 Nature damage and reducing their attack speed by 20% for 15 sec.'

nodes.name: Harden
nodes.description: Learn Harden, hardening your carapace to reduce damage taken. Requires Beetle Form.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 30, 3 min cooldown, 'reducing damage taken by 45%, decaying quickly over 10 sec and healing for 1% maximum health each time a stack is removed. Leaving Beetle Form will cancel this effect.' Fortitude's real capstone-tier defensive cooldown.
